    Motion Optimization¶

    Offline optimization of motion clips before training. The one optimizer that ships is TCRS, which turns flat-ground biped clips into terrain-adapted ones: gait-phase and contact detection, MPPI foot-swing planning against a terrain height field, support-aware pelvis-height filtering, and whole-body Jacobian IK on a MuJoCo model of the robot. It needs no Eden env (numpy, scipy and mujoco only). Datasets reach it through the TCRSTerrainAdapt dataset modifier. The TCRS terrain adaptation guide explains the method and its settings.

    from eden.extensions.motion_optimization.tcrs import HeightFieldTerrain, TCRSPlannerOptions, TCRSRobotOptions

    Options¶

    Configuration options for the offline motion-optimization extensions.

    Holds the config surface of the TCRS terrain-adaptive motion optimizer (:mod:eden.extensions.motion_optimization.tcrs).

    Upstream TCRS hardcodes Unitree G1 geometry (body/joint names, foot contact offsets, leg reach) across several modules. The port lifts all of it into :class:TCRSRobotOptions so another biped can be targeted without touching the algorithms; the no-argument default reproduces the upstream G1 values with the name lists taken from Eden's canonical G1 definitions.

    :class:TCRSPlannerOptions collects the pipeline knobs that upstream exposed as CLI flags (defaults preserved). Both are :class:ConfigurableOptions (extra="forbid"), matching Eden's library-wide config pattern; the TCRS engine consumes them as read-only attribute bags and stays env-free.

    Classes¶

    TCRSRobotOptions ¶

    TCRSRobotOptions(**data)

    Bases: ConfigurableOptions

    Robot geometry and naming the TCRS pipeline needs.

    The no-argument default is the upstream Unitree G1 spec with Eden's canonical name lists as clip orderings. There is no separate override API: construction is always overrides-on-the-G1-defaults — any unspecified field keeps its G1 value, and targeting another biped just means overriding more of them. Eden clips store joints in G1_DOFS29_NAME (chain) order; upstream PMT clips use an interleaved "policy" order. Both are supported — pass the clip's actual ordering; every consumer resolves columns by name.

    def __init__(self, **data):
    # Seed type metadata as construction data so BaseModel validates it into
    # __pydantic_extra__ (no-op for extra="forbid" classes, which use
    # the serialization envelope instead).
    data.update(option_metadata(self))
    # NOTE: all of the option modifications/validations should be done in the __init__ method
    try:
        BaseModel.__init__(self, **data)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        # A misspelled field on an extra="forbid" class should teach the field set, not just
        # name the typo. Only rewritten when every error is extra_forbidden.
        enriched = _enrich_extra_forbidden(type(self), exc)
        if enriched is None:
            raise
        raise enriched from None

    def merged_ik_solver_config(solver_overrides: dict) -> dict:
    """Merge a (possibly partial) ``ik_config["solver"]`` section over the defaults.

    ``DEFAULT_IK_CONFIG["solver"]`` is the complete set of solver knobs; every consumer
    (:meth:`~eden.extensions.motion_optimization.tcrs.ik.JacobianIK.from_config`, the pipeline's
    root-weight lookup) reads the merged dict, so a partial
    override changes exactly the named keys and never falls back to a second,
    disagreeing set of hardcoded defaults. Unknown keys raise.
    """
    valid = set(DEFAULT_IK_CONFIG["solver"])
    unknown = set(solver_overrides) - valid
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown ik_config solver key(s) {sorted(unknown)}. Valid solver keys: {sorted(valid)}.")
    return {**copy.deepcopy(DEFAULT_IK_CONFIG["solver"]), **solver_overrides}

    merged_ik_config ¶

    merged_ik_config(overrides: dict) -> dict

    Deep-merge a partial ik_config dict onto :data:DEFAULT_IK_CONFIG.

    Merge semantics:

    • solver: key-wise merge over the default solver section; unknown solver keys raise (see :func:merged_ik_solver_config).
    • link_weights: per-link-name merge — each override entry is merged over the default entry of the same name (so {"pelvis": {"pos_weight": 2}} keeps the default rot_weight); names absent from the defaults are added as new constraints.

    Sections other than solver/link_weights raise.

    def merged_ik_config(overrides: dict) -> dict:
    """Deep-merge a partial ``ik_config`` dict onto :data:`DEFAULT_IK_CONFIG`.

    Merge semantics:

    - ``solver``: key-wise merge over the default solver section; unknown
      solver keys raise (see :func:`merged_ik_solver_config`).
    - ``link_weights``: per-link-name merge — each override entry is merged
      over the default entry of the same name (so ``{"pelvis": {"pos_weight": 2}}``
      keeps the default ``rot_weight``); names absent from the defaults are
      added as new constraints.

    Sections other than ``solver``/``link_weights`` raise.
    """
    if not isinstance(overrides, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"ik_config overrides must be a dict; got {type(overrides).__name__}.")
    if "body_weights" in overrides:
        raise ValueError(
            "ik_config has no 'body_weights' section: Eden names it 'link_weights' (its dofs_*/links_* naming "
            "convention); rename the section to 'link_weights'."
        )
    unknown_sections = set(overrides) - {"link_weights", "solver"}
    if unknown_sections:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Unknown ik_config section(s) {sorted(unknown_sections)}. Valid sections: ['link_weights', 'solver']."
        )
    merged = copy.deepcopy(DEFAULT_IK_CONFIG)
    merged["solver"] = merged_ik_solver_config(overrides.get("solver", {}))
    for link_name, weights in overrides.get("link_weights", {}).items():
        merged["link_weights"][link_name] = {**merged["link_weights"].get(link_name, {}), **weights}
    return merged

    Pipeline¶

    Offline TCRS pipeline: terrain-adaptive whole-body motion optimization.

    Pipeline stages (per clip): 1. Build a :class:~eden.extensions.motion_optimization.tcrs.motion.MotionClip from raw arrays (contact masks + gait-phase clock are derived on construction). 2. Apply an SE(2) placement transform (yaw about the frame-0 pelvis, then xy translation). 3. Build :class:~eden.extensions.motion_optimization.tcrs.motion.TerrainReference + FootstepResolver (snap footholds onto safe terrain support surfaces). 4. MPPI-optimize every swing-foot trajectory on the mid-foot virtual point (:func:precompute_mppi_foot), then post-process: lateral separation clamps, side-wall pushes, capsule-based leg/foot collision resolution, stance latching. 5. Filter the pelvis z with :class:~eden.extensions.motion_optimization.tcrs.terrain_warp.SupportAwareRootZFilter against a reach-bounded terrain-driven target. 6. Solve per-frame whole-body Jacobian IK (with the lower-body stance stabilizer post-pass) and record raw / ghost-FK / optimized motion sets. 7. Zero-phase lowpass the optimized output's lower body for export.

    Ported from Mondo-Robotics/PMT TCRS/stair_mppi/mppi_foot_planner_smooth.py @ 88838ca (offline pipeline only; viewer, plum mode, window/trajectory IK, curobo/drake backends and batch CLI not ported). The small joint/body reorder helpers come from the same repo's TCRS/stair_mppi/minimal_mppi_demo.py; the mapping builders were rewritten to resolve joints by name via jnt_qposadr instead of actuator ids.

    Methods:¶

    TCRSMotionAdapter ¶

    TCRSMotionAdapter(model_path: str, robot_spec: TCRSRobotOptions | None = None, params: TCRSPlannerOptions | None = None)

    Terrain-adaptive motion optimizer: adapts flat-ground clips to a terrain.

    Loads the MuJoCo model once and reuses the IK solver across :meth:adapt calls; each call allocates fresh MjData so no state leaks between clips.

    PARAMETER DESCRIPTION
    model_path

    def __init__(
    self,
    model_path: str,
    robot_spec: TCRSRobotOptions | None = None,
    params: TCRSPlannerOptions | None = None,
):
    self.robot_spec = robot_spec if robot_spec is not None else TCRSRobotOptions()
    self.params = params if params is not None else TCRSPlannerOptions()
    self.model = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path(str(model_path))
    if self.model.njnt == 0 or self.model.jnt_type[0] != mujoco.mjtJoint.mjJNT_FREE:
        raise ValueError(
            f"The MuJoCo model at '{model_path}' must have a free joint first (floating base); "
            "the pipeline addresses qpos as [root(7), joints...]."
        )
    n_model_joints = self.model.nq - 7
    if len(self.robot_spec.dofs_name) != n_model_joints:
        raise ValueError(
            f"TCRSRobotOptions.dofs_name has {len(self.robot_spec.dofs_name)} joints but the MuJoCo model at "
            f"'{model_path}' has nq-7={n_model_joints} joint DOFs; the clip joint order must cover exactly "
            "the model's non-root joints."
        )
    self.dofs_mapping = build_dofs_mapping(self.model, self.robot_spec.dofs_name)
    self.links_mapping = build_links_mapping(self.model, self.robot_spec.links_name)
    self.ik_solver, self.root_xy_weight, self.root_z_weight = _build_ik_solver(
        self.model, self.robot_spec, log_config=False
    )

    def adapt(
    self,
    clip: ClipArrays,
    terrain: TerrainSource,
    dx: float = 0.0,
    dy: float = 0.0,
    dyaw: float = 0.0,
) -> AdaptResult:
    """Run the full pipeline for one clip with a given SE(2) placement transform.

    Parameters
    ----------
    clip : ClipArrays
        Input motion arrays.
    terrain : TerrainSource
        Terrain height source.
    dx : float
        X translation applied after the yaw rotation (m).
    dy : float
        Y translation applied after the yaw rotation (m).
    dyaw : float
        Yaw rotation about the frame-0 pelvis xy (rad).

    Returns
    -------
    AdaptResult
        Raw / ghost / optimized motion sets and IK quality metrics.
    """
    robot_spec = self.robot_spec
    params = self.params

    # ===== Load motion =====
    motion = MotionClip(
        robot_spec=robot_spec,
        fps=clip.fps,
        dofs_pos=clip.dofs_pos,
        links_pos_w=clip.links_pos_w,
        links_quat_w=clip.links_quat_w,
        links_lin_vel_w=clip.links_lin_vel_w,
        contact_z_threshold=params.contact_z_threshold,
        contact_speed_threshold=params.contact_speed_threshold,
    )
    phase_clock_trusted = _should_trust_phase_clock(motion.phase_params)
    if motion.phase_params is not None:
        pp = motion.phase_params
        trust_str = "trusted" if phase_clock_trusted else "disabled"
        en.logger.info(f"  Phase clock: type={pp.gait_type} fit={pp.fit_quality:.2f} [{trust_str}]")

    # ===== Apply SE(2) transform (dx, dy, dyaw) =====
    _apply_se2_transform(motion, dx, dy, dyaw, robot_spec.pelvis_index)

    N = motion.n_frames
    fps = float(motion.fps)

    # ===== Terrain reference =====
    ref_builder = TerrainReference(
        terrain=terrain,
        motion=motion,
        lookahead=params.lookahead,
        smoothing_alpha=params.smoothing_alpha,
        toe_offset_x=robot_spec.toe_probe_offset_x,
        heel_offset_x=params.heel_offset_x,
        mid_offset_x=params.mid_offset_x,
        swing_floor_margin=params.swing_floor_margin,
    )

    # ===== Swing trajectory optimization =====
    midfoot_contact_z = motion.foot_nominal_z + float(np.asarray(robot_spec.mid_foot_offset)[2])
    opt_params = MppiFootParams(
        n_knots=params.mppi_n_knots,
        n_samples=params.mppi_n_samples,
        n_iterations=params.mppi_n_iterations,
        temperature=params.mppi_temperature,
        w_track=params.w_track,
        w_terrain=params.w_terrain,
        h_clearance=params.h_clearance,
        h_contact_z=midfoot_contact_z,
        seed=params.seed,
    )

    pelvis_quats = motion.links_quat[:, robot_spec.pelvis_index]

    # ===== Enforce lateral separation: prevent L/R foot xy crossover =====
    _min_lateral_sep = 0.02
    _pelvis_xy = motion.links_pos[:, robot_spec.pelvis_index, :2]
    for i in range(len(pelvis_quats)):
        yaw = float(yaw_from_quat(pelvis_quats[i]))
        lat = np.array([-np.sin(yaw), np.cos(yaw)])
        lf_lat = np.dot(ref_builder.left_precomputed[i, :2] - _pelvis_xy[i], lat)
        rf_lat = np.dot(ref_builder.right_precomputed[i, :2] - _pelvis_xy[i], lat)
        if lf_lat - rf_lat < _min_lateral_sep:
            deficit = _min_lateral_sep - (lf_lat - rf_lat)
            ref_builder.left_precomputed[i, :2] += 0.5 * deficit * lat
            ref_builder.right_precomputed[i, :2] -= 0.5 * deficit * lat

    mppi_lfoot, mppi_lfoot_quats = precompute_mppi_foot(
        ref_builder.left_precomputed,
        ref_builder.left_precomputed_quats,
        motion.left_contact,
        motion.foot_nominal_z,
        terrain,
        opt_params,
        motion.fps,
        robot_spec=robot_spec,
    )
    mppi_rfoot, mppi_rfoot_quats = precompute_mppi_foot(
        ref_builder.right_precomputed,
        ref_builder.right_precomputed_quats,
        motion.right_contact,
        motion.foot_nominal_z,
        terrain,
        opt_params,
        motion.fps,
        robot_spec=robot_spec,
    )

    # Post-MPPI lateral clamp: MPPI may re-introduce crossover via terrain avoidance,
    # so the same 2 cm separation as before MPPI is applied to its output.
    _min_lateral_sep = 0.02
    _pelvis_xy = motion.links_pos[:, robot_spec.pelvis_index, :2]
    _n_post_fixed = 0
    for i in range(N):
        yaw = float(yaw_from_quat(pelvis_quats[i]))
        lat = np.array([-np.sin(yaw), np.cos(yaw)])
        lf_lat = np.dot(mppi_lfoot[i, :2] - _pelvis_xy[i], lat)
        rf_lat = np.dot(mppi_rfoot[i, :2] - _pelvis_xy[i], lat)
        if lf_lat - rf_lat < _min_lateral_sep:
            deficit = _min_lateral_sep - (lf_lat - rf_lat)
            mppi_lfoot[i, :2] += 0.5 * deficit * lat
            mppi_rfoot[i, :2] -= 0.5 * deficit * lat
            _n_post_fixed += 1
    if _n_post_fixed > 0:
        en.logger.info(f"  Post-MPPI lateral clamp: {_n_post_fixed}/{N} frames")

    # ===== Post-MPPI side-wall collision fix =====
    # Probe horizontally (terrain.foot_side_penetration) and push feet away from terrain side walls.
    if hasattr(terrain, "foot_side_penetration"):
        _n_side_fixed = 0
        for i in range(N):
            yaw = float(yaw_from_quat(pelvis_quats[i]))
            fx, fy = np.cos(yaw), np.sin(yaw)
            # Left foot
            px_l, py_l = _push_side(terrain, mppi_lfoot[i], fx, fy)
            if abs(px_l) > 1e-4 or abs(py_l) > 1e-4:
                mppi_lfoot[i, 0] += px_l
                mppi_lfoot[i, 1] += py_l
                _n_side_fixed += 1
            # Right foot
            px_r, py_r = _push_side(terrain, mppi_rfoot[i], fx, fy)
            if abs(px_r) > 1e-4 or abs(py_r) > 1e-4:
                mppi_rfoot[i, 0] += px_r
                mppi_rfoot[i, 1] += py_r
                _n_side_fixed += 1
        if _n_side_fixed > 0:
            en.logger.info(f"  Post-MPPI side-wall fix: {_n_side_fixed} foot-frames pushed")

    # ===== Pelvis z: construct target externally, filter only smooths =====
    #   support_z   — terrain-driven weighted foot height
    #   z_anchor    — support_z + nominal clearance
    #   z_style     — zero-mean relative pelvis variation from raw motion
    #   z_target    — z_anchor + z_style, clamped by reachability
    root_z_filter = SupportAwareRootZFilter(
        alpha_up=0.5,
        alpha_down=0.35,
        max_delta=0.035,
    )
    raw_pelvis = motion.links_pos[:, robot_spec.pelvis_index].copy()
    nominal_root_clearance = float(motion.pelvis_height_above_foot)
    raw_pelvis_z0 = float(raw_pelvis[0, 2])
    raw_style_z = raw_pelvis[:, 2] - raw_pelvis_z0
    max_reach = robot_spec.max_reach

    pelvis_z_out = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.float64)
    root_z_filter.reset()
    for i in range(N):
        lw, rw, is_flight = _support_state(motion, i, phase_clock_trusted)

        w_sum = lw + rw
        if w_sum > 1e-6:
            wn = np.array([lw, rw]) / w_sum
            support_z = float(wn[0] * mppi_lfoot[i, 2] + wn[1] * mppi_rfoot[i, 2])
        else:
            support_z = float(terrain.height_at(float(raw_pelvis[i, 0]), float(raw_pelvis[i, 1])))

        z_anchor = support_z + nominal_root_clearance
        z_target = z_anchor + float(raw_style_z[i])

        z_upper_candidates = []
        if lw > 1e-3:
            z_upper_candidates.append(_pelvis_reach_z_upper_bound(raw_pelvis[i, :2], mppi_lfoot[i], lw, max_reach))
        if rw > 1e-3:
            z_upper_candidates.append(_pelvis_reach_z_upper_bound(raw_pelvis[i, :2], mppi_rfoot[i], rw, max_reach))
        if not z_upper_candidates:
            z_upper_candidates.extend(
                [
                    _pelvis_reach_z_upper_bound(raw_pelvis[i, :2], mppi_lfoot[i], 0.0, max_reach),
                    _pelvis_reach_z_upper_bound(raw_pelvis[i, :2], mppi_rfoot[i], 0.0, max_reach),
                ]
            )
        z_target = min(z_target, min(z_upper_candidates))

        pelvis_z_out[i] = root_z_filter.step(z_target, is_flight=is_flight)

    pelvis_positions = raw_pelvis.copy()
    pelvis_positions[:, 2] = pelvis_z_out

    # ===== Collision resolution =====
    if params.leg_collision_iters > 0:
        mppi_lfoot, mppi_rfoot = _resolve_lower_leg_foot_collisions(
            motion,
            pelvis_positions,
            mppi_lfoot,
            mppi_rfoot,
            mppi_lfoot_quats,
            mppi_rfoot_quats,
            motion.left_contact,
            motion.right_contact,
            terrain,
            motion.foot_nominal_z,
            n_iters=params.leg_collision_iters,
            shin_radius=params.shin_collision_radius,
            foot_radius=params.foot_collision_radius,
            collision_margin=params.leg_collision_margin,
            push_gain=params.collision_push_gain,
            max_push_per_frame=params.collision_max_push,
            pelvis_side_margin=params.pelvis_side_margin,
            pelvis_side_gain=params.pelvis_side_gain,
        )

    # Remove stance-foot target drift: each stance run keeps the first grounded stance xyz.
    if params.stance_latch:
        mppi_lfoot = _latch_stance_foot_targets(
            mppi_lfoot,
            motion.left_contact,
            terrain,
            motion.foot_nominal_z,
            ground_tol=params.stance_latch_ground_tol,
        )
        mppi_rfoot = _latch_stance_foot_targets(
            mppi_rfoot,
            motion.right_contact,
            terrain,
            motion.foot_nominal_z,
            ground_tol=params.stance_latch_ground_tol,
        )

    left_point_scales = _precompute_contact_point_scales(
        mppi_lfoot,
        mppi_lfoot_quats,
        motion.left_contact,
        terrain,
        robot_spec,
    )
    right_point_scales = _precompute_contact_point_scales(
        mppi_rfoot,
        mppi_rfoot_quats,
        motion.right_contact,
        terrain,
        robot_spec,
    )

    # ===== MuJoCo model + IK setup (model/solver reused from __init__) =====
    model = self.model
    data = mujoco.MjData(model)
    dofs_mapping = self.dofs_mapping
    links_mapping = self.links_mapping
    ik_solver = self.ik_solver
    root_xy_weight = self.root_xy_weight
    root_z_weight = self.root_z_weight

    # Ghost FK model (for offset/ghost recording)
    ghost_model, ghost_data = _build_ghost_fk_model(model)

    n_links_export = len(robot_spec.links_name)
    n_dofs = model.nq - 7  # 29 for G1

    # Buffers: raw is read from motion directly
    # Ghost (offset): raw joints + terrain-adjusted pelvis z
    ghost_dofs_pos = np.zeros((N, n_dofs), dtype=np.float64)
    ghost_links_pos = np.zeros((N, n_links_export, 3), dtype=np.float64)
    ghost_links_quat = np.zeros((N, n_links_export, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    # Optimized (MPPI + IK)
    opt_dofs_pos = np.zeros((N, n_dofs), dtype=np.float64)
    opt_links_pos = np.zeros((N, n_links_export, 3), dtype=np.float64)
    opt_links_quat = np.zeros((N, n_links_export, 4), dtype=np.float64)

    frame_targets, locked_double_stance = _build_frame_ik_targets(
        motion,
        pelvis_positions,
        mppi_lfoot,
        mppi_rfoot,
        mppi_lfoot_quats,
        mppi_rfoot_quats,
        dofs_mapping,
        ik_solver,
        left_point_scales,
        right_point_scales,
        root_xy_weight,
        root_z_weight,
        phase_clock_trusted,
    )

    solved_states, _ = _solve_ik_state_sequence(
        params,
        data,
        ik_solver,
        frame_targets,
        locked_double_stance,
        motion.left_contact[:N],
        motion.right_contact[:N],
        init_progress_prefix=None,
        init_progress_every=200,
        lb_progress_prefix="    [lb-stab]",
        lb_progress_every=200,
    )
    ik_pos_errors = _record_solved_sequence(
        data,
        ghost_model,
        ghost_data,
        ik_solver,
        frame_targets,
        solved_states,
        links_mapping,
        dofs_mapping,
        pelvis_positions,
        opt_dofs_pos,
        opt_links_pos,
        opt_links_quat,
        ghost_dofs_pos,
        ghost_links_pos,
        ghost_links_quat,
        motion,
    )

    # IK error summary
    ik_pos_errors = np.array(ik_pos_errors)
    en.logger.info(
        f"  IK summary: p50={np.percentile(ik_pos_errors, 50):.0f}mm "
        f"p95={np.percentile(ik_pos_errors, 95):.0f}mm "
        f"max={ik_pos_errors.max():.0f}mm  "
        f"bad(>{params.reject_ik_mm:.0f}mm)={np.sum(ik_pos_errors > float(params.reject_ik_mm))}/{N}"
    )

    raw_dofs_pos = motion.dofs_pos[:N].copy()
    raw_links_pos = motion.links_pos[:N].copy()
    raw_links_quat = motion.links_quat[:N].copy()

    # Export lowpass on the optimized output only (raw and ghost stay unfiltered,
    # matching the upstream batch export path).
    effective_cutoff = params.lowpass_cutoff_hz
    if effective_cutoff > 0:
        opt_dofs_pos, opt_links_pos, opt_links_quat = filter_lower_body_motion_for_export(
            model,
            robot_spec,
            dofs_mapping,
            links_mapping,
            opt_dofs_pos,
            opt_links_pos,
            opt_links_quat,
            fps,
            cutoff_hz=effective_cutoff,
            order=params.lowpass_order,
        )

    return AdaptResult(
        raw=MotionSet(dofs_pos=raw_dofs_pos, links_pos_w=raw_links_pos, links_quat_w=raw_links_quat),
        ghost=MotionSet(dofs_pos=ghost_dofs_pos, links_pos_w=ghost_links_pos, links_quat_w=ghost_links_quat),
        optimized=MotionSet(dofs_pos=opt_dofs_pos, links_pos_w=opt_links_pos, links_quat_w=opt_links_quat),
        left_contact=motion.left_contact.copy(),
        right_contact=motion.right_contact.copy(),
        ik_pos_errors=ik_pos_errors.copy(),
        ik_bad_frame_count=int(np.sum(ik_pos_errors > float(params.reject_ik_mm))),
    )

    def build_dofs_mapping(model: mujoco.MjModel, dofs_name: list[str]) -> list[int]:
    """Clip joint column i -> index into qpos[7:], resolved by joint name via jnt_qposadr."""
    mapping = []
    for name in dofs_name:
        jid = mujoco.mj_name2id(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT, name)
        if jid == -1:
            raise ValueError(f"Joint '{name}' not found in the MuJoCo model")
        # int() coercion: `x in (enum, ...)` compares with the pybind enum on the left, and
        # mujoco >= 3.12's enums answer False to a numpy scalar there (plain `x == enum` is fine).
        if int(model.jnt_type[jid]) not in (mujoco.mjtJoint.mjJNT_HINGE, mujoco.mjtJoint.mjJNT_SLIDE):
            raise ValueError(f"Joint '{name}' is not a 1-DOF joint")
        mapping.append(int(model.jnt_qposadr[jid]) - 7)
    return mapping

    def build_links_mapping(model: mujoco.MjModel, links_name: list[str]) -> list[int]:
    """Build mapping from clip link index to MuJoCo body id: ``mapping[clip_idx] = mujoco_body_id``."""
    mapping = []
    for name in links_name:
        bid = mujoco.mj_name2id(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, name)
        if bid == -1:
            raise ValueError(f"Body '{name}' not found in MuJoCo model")
        mapping.append(bid)
    return mapping

    def reorder_to_mujoco(values, mapping):
    """Reorder a (n_dofs,) clip-order vector into MuJoCo qpos[7:] order."""
    out = np.zeros_like(values)
    for policy_idx, mujoco_idx in enumerate(mapping):
        out[mujoco_idx] = values[policy_idx]
    return out

    def update_robot_pose(data, root_pos, root_quat, dofs_qpos):
    """Write a root pose + joint vector into a MuJoCo data (velocities/controls zeroed)."""
    data.qpos[:3] = np.asarray(root_pos, dtype=np.float64)
    data.qpos[3:7] = np.asarray(root_quat, dtype=np.float64)
    data.qpos[7:] = np.asarray(dofs_qpos, dtype=np.float64)
    data.qvel[:] = 0.0
    data.ctrl[:] = 0.0

    def precompute_mppi_foot(
    precomputed_ref,
    precomputed_quats,
    contact_mask,
    foot_nominal_z,
    terrain,
    mppi_params,
    fps,
    robot_spec,
):
    """Run MPPI trajectory optimization over all swing phases of one foot.

    Core idea: plan on the mid-foot virtual center (midpoint of toe and heel)
    rather than the ankle origin. The planning point sits closer to the ground
    contact surface, reducing toe/heel penetration at step edges. After
    optimization the mid-foot result is transformed back to ankle coordinates
    for IK.

    A swing between stances at the same height (< 1.5 cm apart) whose reference
    clears the terrain is kept as it is.

    Parameters
    ----------
    precomputed_ref : np.ndarray
        (N, 3) ankle reference positions from TerrainReference.
    precomputed_quats : np.ndarray
        (N, 4) ankle reference quaternions (wxyz) from TerrainReference.
    contact_mask : np.ndarray
        (N,) boolean contact mask (True = stance, False = swing).
    foot_nominal_z : float
        Nominal ankle z height on flat ground (m).
    terrain : TerrainSource
        Terrain height source.
    mppi_params : MppiFootParams
        Optimizer parameters.
    fps : float
        Motion frame rate (Hz).
    robot_spec : TCRSRobotOptions
        Robot geometry; provides the mid-foot offset for the ankle<->midfoot conversion.

    Returns
    -------
    optimized_pos : np.ndarray
        (N, 3) ankle positions (stance frames unchanged, optimized swing frames overwritten).
    optimized_quats : np.ndarray
        (N, 4) quaternions: yaw-only during stance (sole stays level), the reference ones
        during swing, slerp-blended over up to 10 frames at each stance boundary.
    """
    opt = MppiFootOptimizer(mppi_params)
    n = len(contact_mask)
    out_pos = precomputed_ref.copy()
    out_quats = precomputed_quats.copy()

    # ===== Step 1: lock stance-phase quaternions to pure yaw =====
    # On discrete stair-like terrain, the stance foot stays level by default (yaw only).
    # This avoids bogus pitch/roll from finite-difference normal estimates at step edges.
    stance_phases = _find_stance_phases(contact_mask)
    for st, en_ in stance_phases:
        yaw = float(yaw_from_quat(precomputed_quats[st]))
        locked_quat = xyz_to_quat(np.array([0.0, 0.0, yaw]))  # yaw-only: sole stays level
        for i in range(st, en_):
            out_quats[i] = locked_quat

    # ===== Step 2: run MPPI optimization for each swing phase =====
    phases = _find_swing_phases(contact_mask)
    _n_skipped = 0

    if len(phases) > 0:
        en.logger.info(f"    MPPI optimizing {len(phases)} swing phases...")

    for phase_idx, (swing_start, swing_end) in enumerate(phases):
        if phase_idx == 0 or (phase_idx + 1) % 5 == 0 or phase_idx == len(phases) - 1:
            en.logger.debug(f"      phase {phase_idx + 1}/{len(phases)} frames=[{swing_start},{swing_end})")
        liftoff_idx = swing_start - 1  # liftoff frame = the frame before the swing starts
        landing_idx = swing_end  # landing frame = the first frame after the swing ends

        # Bounds check: skip optimization if the liftoff/landing frame is out of range.
        # Swing frames keep the original mocap quaternions (precomputed_quats), not overwritten.
        if liftoff_idx < 0 or landing_idx >= n:
            continue

        # ===== Conditional skip: preserve original motion when possible =====
        # Check height difference between consecutive stances
        liftoff_z = float(out_pos[liftoff_idx, 2])
        landing_z = float(out_pos[landing_idx, 2])
        height_diff = abs(landing_z - liftoff_z)

        if height_diff < 0.015:  # Same level (< 1.5cm height change)
            # Check: does the original swing trajectory collide with terrain?
            _has_collision = False
            _clearance_margin = mppi_params.h_clearance if hasattr(mppi_params, "h_clearance") else 0.02
            for _k in range(swing_start, swing_end):
                _fx, _fy, _fz = precomputed_ref[_k]
                _tz = float(terrain.height_at(_fx, _fy))
                if _fz < _tz + foot_nominal_z + _clearance_margin:
                    _has_collision = True
                    break

            if not _has_collision:
                # SKIP: no height change, no collision → keep original trajectory
                _n_skipped += 1
                continue

        n_swing = swing_end - swing_start  # number of frames in the swing phase

        # --- Swing quaternions: keep the original mocap quaternions, tracking the
        # reference motion's pitch/roll ---
        # The stance phase was locked to pure yaw (level sole) in step 1;
        # the swing phase keeps the original mocap values from precomputed_quats.
        # Slerp over blend_frames frames at the start and end of the swing to avoid
        # quaternion jumps at the stance (pure yaw) -> swing (mocap) boundary.
        blend_frames = min(10, n_swing // 2)  # number of transition frames, at most half a swing
        if blend_frames > 0:
            q_liftoff = out_quats[liftoff_idx]  # pure yaw (locked during stance)
            q_landing = out_quats[landing_idx]  # pure yaw (locked during stance)
            # Swing start: transition from liftoff pure yaw to mocap
            for b in range(blend_frames):
                alpha = (b + 1) / (blend_frames + 1)  # 0 -> 1 excluding the endpoints
                idx_b = swing_start + b
                q_mocap = precomputed_quats[idx_b]
                q_blend = slerp_quaternion(q_liftoff, q_mocap, np.array([alpha]))[0]
                out_quats[idx_b] = q_blend
            # Swing end: transition from mocap to landing pure yaw
            for b in range(blend_frames):
                alpha = (b + 1) / (blend_frames + 1)
                idx_b = swing_end - blend_frames + b
                q_mocap = precomputed_quats[idx_b]
                q_blend = slerp_quaternion(q_mocap, q_landing, np.array([alpha]))[0]
                out_quats[idx_b] = q_blend

        # --- Convert ankle coordinates to mid-foot coordinates for MPPI planning ---
        liftoff_midfoot = _ankle_to_midfoot(out_pos[liftoff_idx], out_quats[liftoff_idx], robot_spec)
        landing_midfoot = _ankle_to_midfoot(out_pos[landing_idx], out_quats[landing_idx], robot_spec)

        # Special case: with fewer than 2 swing frames MPPI cannot optimize
        # (at least 2 frames are needed to form a valid trajectory) — use linear
        # interpolation instead.
        if n_swing < 2:
            t_frac = np.linspace(0, 1, n_swing + 2)[1:-1]  # drop the two endpoint samples
            for k, frac in enumerate(t_frac):
                midfoot_interp = (1 - frac) * liftoff_midfoot + frac * landing_midfoot
                out_pos[swing_start + k] = _midfoot_to_ankle(midfoot_interp, out_quats[swing_start + k], robot_spec)
            continue

        swing_duration = n_swing / fps  # swing duration (seconds)
        ref_indices = np.arange(swing_start, swing_end)  # indices of the swing frames

        # --- Build the MPPI tracking target: convert reference ankle positions to
        # mid-foot coordinates ---
        ref_traj_midfoot = np.zeros((n_swing, 3), dtype=np.float64)
        for k, idx in enumerate(ref_indices):
            ref_traj_midfoot[k] = _ankle_to_midfoot(precomputed_ref[idx], out_quats[idx], robot_spec)
        ref_times = np.linspace(0, swing_duration, n_swing)  # time sample points

        # optimize_swing samples xyz jointly: tracking + smoothness costs, plus
        # terrain-penetration and height-ceiling penalties on z.
        try:
            traj_x, traj_y, traj_z = opt.optimize_swing(
                liftoff_midfoot,
                landing_midfoot,
                swing_duration,
                ref_traj_midfoot,
                ref_times,
                terrain,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            en.logger.warning(f"  [MPPI] Warning: swing [{swing_start}:{swing_end}] failed: {e}")
            continue  # keep the original TerrainReference trajectory when optimization fails

        # --- Evaluate the optimized mid-foot trajectory and convert back to ankle
        # coordinates ---
        t_eval = np.linspace(0, swing_duration, n_swing)
        midfoot_x = traj_x.eval(t_eval)
        midfoot_y = traj_y.eval(t_eval)
        midfoot_z = traj_z.eval(t_eval)

        for k, idx in enumerate(ref_indices):
            midfoot_pos = np.array([midfoot_x[k], midfoot_y[k], midfoot_z[k]])
            out_pos[idx] = _midfoot_to_ankle(midfoot_pos, out_quats[idx], robot_spec)  # mid-foot -> ankle

        # --- Blend back toward original ref if landing at same height ---
        # When MPPI was needed (collision on flat ground), blend the end of
        # the swing back toward the precomputed_ref to restore original motion shape.
        if height_diff < 0.015 and n_swing > 6:
            _blend_start = swing_start + int(0.7 * n_swing)
            for _k in range(_blend_start, swing_end):
                _alpha = (_k - _blend_start) / max(swing_end - _blend_start, 1)
                out_pos[_k] = (1.0 - _alpha) * out_pos[_k] + _alpha * precomputed_ref[_k]

    if _n_skipped > 0:
        en.logger.info(f"    Skipped {_n_skipped}/{len(phases)} swing phases (no height change, no collision)")

    return out_pos, out_quats

    def apply_zero_phase_lowpass(traj, fps, cutoff_hz=10.0, order=4):
    """Zero-phase Butterworth lowpass on a (N,D) or (N,) array.

    Uses scipy.signal.filtfilt for zero phase shift.
    Gracefully handles short sequences: if the signal is too short for
    the requested filter order, the order is reduced until filtfilt can
    run, or the original is returned unfiltered.
    """
    from scipy.signal import butter, filtfilt

    if cutoff_hz <= 0:
        return traj.copy()
    nyquist = fps / 2.0
    if cutoff_hz >= nyquist:
        return traj.copy()

    traj = np.asarray(traj, dtype=np.float64)
    N = traj.shape[0]

    # filtfilt requires padlen <= N - 1; default padlen = 3 * max(len(a), len(b))
    # For butter order k: len(b) = len(a) = k + 1, so padlen = 3 * (k + 1).
    # If N is too short, reduce order until it fits, or skip.
    eff_order = int(order)
    while eff_order >= 1:
        padlen = 3 * (eff_order + 1)
        if padlen < N:
            break
        eff_order -= 1
    if eff_order < 1:
        return traj.copy()  # too short to filter at all

    b, a = butter(eff_order, cutoff_hz / nyquist, btype="low")

    def _filt1d(x):
        return filtfilt(b, a, x)

    if traj.ndim == 1:
        return _filt1d(traj)
    out = np.empty_like(traj)
    if traj.ndim == 2:
        for j in range(traj.shape[1]):
            out[:, j] = _filt1d(traj[:, j])
    elif traj.ndim == 3:
        for b_idx in range(traj.shape[1]):
            for d in range(traj.shape[2]):
                out[:, b_idx, d] = _filt1d(traj[:, b_idx, d])
    else:
        out = traj.copy()
    return out

    def filter_motion_for_export(
    dofs_pos,
    links_pos,
    links_quat,
    fps,
    cutoff_hz=10.0,
    order=4,
):
    """Apply zero-phase lowpass to all exported channels consistently.

    - dofs_pos, links_pos: Butterworth filtfilt.
    - links_quat: log-map → filtfilt → exp-map (proper SO(3) smoothing).

    (Upstream also recomputed velocities from the filtered channels; the port
    returns positions/quaternions only.)
    """
    if cutoff_hz <= 0:
        return dofs_pos.copy(), links_pos.copy(), links_quat.copy()

    filt_dofs_pos = apply_zero_phase_lowpass(dofs_pos, fps, cutoff_hz, order)
    filt_links_pos = apply_zero_phase_lowpass(links_pos, fps, cutoff_hz, order)
    filt_links_quat = _smooth_quaternions_logmap(links_quat, fps, cutoff_hz, order)
    return filt_dofs_pos, filt_links_pos, filt_links_quat

    def filter_lower_body_motion_for_export(
    model,
    robot_spec,
    dofs_mapping,
    links_mapping,
    dofs_pos,
    links_pos,
    links_quat,
    fps,
    cutoff_hz=5.0,
    order=4,
):
    """Smooth root position + waist + leg joints, then rebuild full-body poses by FK.

    This preserves shoulder/elbow/wrist motion while making the support chain
    smoother and keeping exported body poses consistent with the exported
    joint commands.

    Root orientation is intentionally left unchanged. Smoothing pelvis
    quaternions over long clips can create catastrophic whole-body heading
    artefacts even when IK position error stays small, because the batch
    error metric does not constrain root orientation.

    (Upstream loaded its own MjModel from the XML and recomputed velocities;
    the port reuses the caller's model/mappings and returns positions only.)
    """
    dofs_pos = np.asarray(dofs_pos, dtype=np.float64)
    links_pos = np.asarray(links_pos, dtype=np.float64)
    links_quat = np.asarray(links_quat, dtype=np.float64)
    if cutoff_hz <= 0:
        return dofs_pos.copy(), links_pos.copy(), links_quat.copy()

    smooth_names = (
        list(robot_spec.left_leg_dofs_name) + list(robot_spec.right_leg_dofs_name) + list(robot_spec.waist_dofs_name)
    )
    smooth_policy_idx = np.array(
        [robot_spec.dofs_name.index(name) for name in smooth_names],
        dtype=np.int64,
    )

    filt_dofs_pos = dofs_pos.copy()
    filt_dofs_pos[:, smooth_policy_idx] = apply_zero_phase_lowpass(
        dofs_pos[:, smooth_policy_idx],
        fps,
        cutoff_hz,
        order,
    )

    filt_root_pos = apply_zero_phase_lowpass(
        links_pos[:, robot_spec.pelvis_index, :],
        fps,
        cutoff_hz,
        order,
    )
    filt_root_quat = links_quat[:, robot_spec.pelvis_index].copy()

    data = mujoco.MjData(model)

    filt_links_pos = np.zeros_like(links_pos, dtype=np.float64)
    filt_links_quat = np.zeros_like(links_quat, dtype=np.float64)
    for t in range(dofs_pos.shape[0]):
        dofs_qpos = reorder_to_mujoco(filt_dofs_pos[t], dofs_mapping)
        update_robot_pose(
            data,
            root_pos=filt_root_pos[t],
            root_quat=filt_root_quat[t],
            dofs_qpos=dofs_qpos,
        )
        mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
        for npz_i, mj_bid in enumerate(links_mapping):
            filt_links_pos[t, npz_i] = data.xpos[mj_bid]
            filt_links_quat[t, npz_i] = data.xquat[mj_bid]

    return filt_dofs_pos, filt_links_pos, filt_links_quat

    Motion clips and terrain references¶

    Motion clip container, footstep resolution, and terrain-adapted reference trajectories.

    :class:MotionClip wraps a mocap segment (joint positions plus world-frame body poses) and derives per-foot contact masks — an adaptive percentile z-threshold combined with a speed gate, stabilized by :func:stabilize_contact_mask — and an optional gait phase clock for gaits with flight phases. :class:FootstepResolver snaps each touchdown to a safe landing pose on the terrain and locks it across the stance phase. :class:TerrainReference builds the terrain-adapted pelvis and foot reference trajectories consumed by the planner (stance-locked footholds, smooth swing interpolation, floor clamping, lateral crossover and step-order enforcement).

    Ported from Mondo-Robotics/PMT TCRS/stair_mppi/minimal_mppi_demo.py @ 88838ca (viewer demo, TinyMPPI and MuJoCo helpers not ported).

    def __init__(
    self,
    robot_spec: TCRSRobotOptions,
    fps: float,
    dofs_pos: np.ndarray,
    links_pos_w: np.ndarray,
    links_quat_w: np.ndarray,
    links_lin_vel_w: np.ndarray | None = None,
    contact_z_threshold: float = 0.06,
    contact_speed_threshold: float = 0.5,
):
    dofs_pos = np.asarray(dofs_pos)
    links_pos_w = np.asarray(links_pos_w)
    links_quat_w = np.asarray(links_quat_w)
    if fps <= 0.0:
        raise ValueError(f"fps must be > 0, got {fps}")
    if dofs_pos.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError(f"dofs_pos must be (T, n_dofs), got shape {dofs_pos.shape}")
    n_frames = int(dofs_pos.shape[0])
    if n_frames == 0:
        raise ValueError("Motion clip is empty (0 frames)")
    n_dofs = len(robot_spec.dofs_name)
    n_links = len(robot_spec.links_name)
    if dofs_pos.shape[1] != n_dofs:
        raise ValueError(f"dofs_pos has {dofs_pos.shape[1]} joints but robot_spec.dofs_name has {n_dofs}")
    if links_pos_w.shape != (n_frames, n_links, 3):
        raise ValueError(
            f"links_pos_w must have shape ({n_frames}, {n_links}, 3) to match dofs_pos frames and "
            f"robot_spec.links_name, got {links_pos_w.shape}"
        )
    if links_quat_w.shape != (n_frames, n_links, 4):
        raise ValueError(f"links_quat_w must have shape ({n_frames}, {n_links}, 4), got {links_quat_w.shape}")
    if links_lin_vel_w is not None:
        links_lin_vel_w = np.asarray(links_lin_vel_w)
        if links_lin_vel_w.shape != (n_frames, n_links, 3):
            raise ValueError(
                f"links_lin_vel_w must have shape ({n_frames}, {n_links}, 3), got {links_lin_vel_w.shape}"
            )

    self.robot_spec = robot_spec
    self.fps = float(fps)
    self.n_frames = n_frames
    self.dofs_pos = dofs_pos.copy()
    self.links_pos = links_pos_w.copy()
    self.links_quat = links_quat_w.copy()
    if links_lin_vel_w is not None:
        self.links_lin_vel = links_lin_vel_w.copy()
    else:
        self.links_lin_vel = np.gradient(self.links_pos, axis=0) * self.fps

    pelvis_idx = robot_spec.pelvis_index
    lfoot_idx = robot_spec.left_foot_index
    rfoot_idx = robot_spec.right_foot_index
    lfoot_speed = np.linalg.norm(self.links_lin_vel[:, lfoot_idx], axis=1)
    rfoot_speed = np.linalg.norm(self.links_lin_vel[:, rfoot_idx], axis=1)
    lfoot_z = self.links_pos[:, lfoot_idx, 2]
    rfoot_z = self.links_pos[:, rfoot_idx, 2]

    # Adaptive contact threshold: percentile-based.
    # Use the 25th percentile of foot z + margin as threshold.
    # This is robust to motions where the ground plane is not at z=0.
    all_foot_z = np.concatenate([lfoot_z, rfoot_z])
    _p25 = float(np.percentile(all_foot_z, 25.0))
    _adaptive_z_thresh = max(float(contact_z_threshold), _p25 + 0.02)
    left_contact_raw = (lfoot_z < _adaptive_z_thresh) & (lfoot_speed < float(contact_speed_threshold))
    right_contact_raw = (rfoot_z < _adaptive_z_thresh) & (rfoot_speed < float(contact_speed_threshold))
    self.left_contact = stabilize_contact_mask(left_contact_raw)
    self.right_contact = stabilize_contact_mask(right_contact_raw)

    # Phase clock fitting — for gaits with flight phases (running/hopping)
    self.phase_params = fit_phase_clock(
        lfoot_z,
        rfoot_z,
        lfoot_speed,
        rfoot_speed,
        self.fps,
        contact_z_threshold,
        contact_speed_threshold,
    )
    if self.phase_params is not None:
        self.per_frame_phase = compute_per_frame_phase(self.phase_params, self.n_frames)
        # Do NOT override contact masks — phase clock can misdetect boundaries.
    else:
        self.per_frame_phase = None

    # The robot's known ankle-to-sole height (upstream: 0.06 m, measured
    # from the G1 ankle_roll_link to the sole).
    self.foot_nominal_z = robot_spec.foot_nominal_z

    # Compute nominal pelvis height above foot contact surface (flat ground).
    # This is the target for pelvis height regulation on terrain.
    pelvis_z = self.links_pos[:, pelvis_idx, 2]
    self.pelvis_height_above_foot = float(np.median(pelvis_z) - self.foot_nominal_z)

    def get_future_support_weights(self, frame: int, horizon: int) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return continuous support weights for pelvis z computation.

    When phase clock is available, returns smooth cosine-decay weights.
    Otherwise, falls back to binary weights from contact masks (1.0/0.0).
    """
    idx = self._future_indices(frame, horizon)
    if self.per_frame_phase is not None:
        return (
            self.per_frame_phase.support_weight_left[idx].copy(),
            self.per_frame_phase.support_weight_right[idx].copy(),
        )
    return (
        self.left_contact[idx].astype(np.float64),
        self.right_contact[idx].astype(np.float64),
    )

    FootstepResolver ¶

    FootstepResolver(robot_spec: TCRSRobotOptions, terrain: TerrainSource, raw_foot: ndarray, contact_mask: ndarray, foot_nominal_z: float, foot_quats: ndarray | None = None, foot_point_offsets: ndarray | None = None, toe_offset_x: float | None = None, max_landing_shift: float = 0.05)

    Footstep resolver: snaps raw mocap ankle positions onto safe terrain support surfaces.

    Core responsibilities:

    1. For each touchdown frame, call :meth:_resolve_landing_pose to find the best support placement, constraining the ankle so all foot key points (heel/midfoot/toe) land on the same support surface.
    2. Broadcast the resolved landing pose across the whole stance phase (contact_support) so the foot does not slide while in contact.
    PARAMETER DESCRIPTION
    robot_spec

    Robot geometry; provides the default toe probe offset.

    TYPE: TCRSRobotOptions

    terrain

    Terrain object; must provide height_at(x, y) and height_batch(x, y).

    TYPE: TerrainSource

    raw_foot

    (N, 3) raw mocap ankle positions (world frame).

    TYPE: ndarray

    contact_mask

    (N,) boolean contact mask; True = stance.

    TYPE: ndarray

    foot_nominal_z

    Nominal ankle z height when standing on flat ground (z=0).

    TYPE: float

    foot_quats

    (N, 4) ankle quaternions [w, x, y, z], used to rotate foot offsets into the world frame. Defaults to identity (facing forward).

    TYPE: ndarray or None DEFAULT: None

    foot_point_offsets

    (M,) local x offsets of foot key points relative to the ankle. Each offset is rotated by the quaternion into world coordinates and checked against step edges. Defaults to [toe_offset_x].

    TYPE: ndarray or None DEFAULT: None

    toe_offset_x

    Toe x offset relative to the ankle (local frame). Defaults to robot_spec.toe_probe_offset_x.

    TYPE: float or None DEFAULT: None

    max_landing_shift

    Maximum search displacement along the foot forward direction in :meth:_resolve_landing_pose (m).

    TYPE: float DEFAULT: 0.05

    def __init__(
    self,
    robot_spec: TCRSRobotOptions,
    terrain: TerrainSource,
    raw_foot: np.ndarray,
    contact_mask: np.ndarray,
    foot_nominal_z: float,
    foot_quats: np.ndarray | None = None,
    foot_point_offsets: np.ndarray | None = None,
    toe_offset_x: float | None = None,
    max_landing_shift: float = 0.05,
):
    if toe_offset_x is None:
        toe_offset_x = robot_spec.toe_probe_offset_x
    self.robot_spec = robot_spec
    self.terrain = terrain
    self.raw_foot = np.asarray(raw_foot, dtype=np.float64)
    self.contact_mask = np.asarray(contact_mask, dtype=bool)
    self.foot_nominal_z = float(foot_nominal_z)
    self.toe_offset_x = max(float(toe_offset_x), 0.0)
    self.max_landing_shift = max(float(max_landing_shift), 0.005)
    self.n_frames = int(self.contact_mask.shape[0])
    if foot_quats is not None:
        self.foot_quats = np.asarray(foot_quats, dtype=np.float64)
    else:
        # Without quaternions, default to facing forward (identity quaternion).
        self.foot_quats = np.tile(
            np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=np.float64),
            (self.n_frames, 1),
        )
    if foot_point_offsets is not None:
        self.foot_point_offsets = np.asarray(foot_point_offsets, dtype=np.float64)
    else:
        self.foot_point_offsets = np.array([toe_offset_x], dtype=np.float64)

    # Detect touchdown events: rising edges from non-contact to contact.
    # contact_mask[i] = True and contact_mask[i-1] = False → frame i is a touchdown frame.
    self.touchdown = self.contact_mask & ~np.r_[False, self.contact_mask[:-1]]
    # If contact frames exist but no rising edge was found (the whole segment is
    # in contact), mark the first contact frame as a touchdown.
    if np.any(self.contact_mask) and not np.any(self.touchdown):
        first_contact = int(np.flatnonzero(self.contact_mask)[0])
        self.touchdown[first_contact] = True

    # For each touchdown frame, resolve a safe landing position
    # (x constrained to the step's safe interval, z = terrain height + foot_nominal_z).
    self.touchdown_support = np.full((self.n_frames, 3), np.nan, dtype=np.float64)
    for td in np.flatnonzero(self.touchdown):
        self.touchdown_support[td] = self._resolve_landing_pose(self.raw_foot[td], self.foot_quats[td])

    # Build prev/next contact-frame index maps (used during swing to find adjacent stance frames).
    (
        self.prev_contact_idx,  # prev_contact_idx[i] = nearest contact frame index before frame i
        self.next_contact_idx,  # next_contact_idx[i] = nearest contact frame index after frame i
    ) = self._build_prev_next_indices(self.contact_mask)
    # Build per-frame "next touchdown frame" indices (wrap=True: wraps to the start past the end).
    self.next_touchdown_idx = self._build_next_event_indices(self.touchdown, wrap=True)

    # Broadcast touchdown landing poses across the whole stance phase:
    # contact_support[i] = the locked position of that stance segment.
    self.contact_support = np.full((self.n_frames, 3), np.nan, dtype=np.float64)
    self._build_contact_support()

    def prev_support_pose(self, frame_idx: int) -> np.ndarray | None:
    """Query the nearest support position before frame ``frame_idx``.

    Used during swing to determine the liftoff position: the contact_support
    of the last contact frame before the swing is the liftoff point.

    Returns
    -------
    np.ndarray or None
        (3,) position array [x, y, z], or None (no preceding support frame).
    """
    idx = int(frame_idx) % self.n_frames
    prev_contact = int(self.prev_contact_idx[idx])
    if prev_contact < 0:
        return None
    pose = self.contact_support[prev_contact]
    if not np.isfinite(pose[2]):
        return None
    return pose.copy()

    def next_touchdown_pose(self, frame_idx: int) -> np.ndarray | None:
    """Query the nearest touchdown (landing) position after frame ``frame_idx``.

    Used during swing to determine the landing target: the safe position the
    foot must reach at the end of the swing.

    Returns
    -------
    np.ndarray or None
        (3,) position array [x, y, z], or None (no subsequent touchdown).
    """
    idx = int(frame_idx) % self.n_frames
    td = int(self.next_touchdown_idx[idx])
    if td < 0:
        return None
    pose = self.touchdown_support[td]
    if not np.isfinite(pose[2]):
        return None
    return pose.copy()

    TerrainReference ¶

    TerrainReference(terrain: TerrainSource, motion: MotionClip, lookahead: float = 0.0, smoothing_alpha: float = 0.08, toe_offset_x: float | None = None, heel_offset_x: float = -0.04, mid_offset_x: float = 0.1, swing_floor_margin: float = 0.003, soft_reach_limit: float = 0.7, max_landing_shift: float = 0.05)

    Terrain reference trajectory builder: adapts raw mocap foot positions to the target terrain.

    Core outputs: left_precomputed / right_precomputed: (N, 3) left/right ankle reference positions. left_precomputed_quats / right_precomputed_quats: (N, 4) left/right ankle reference quaternions.

    Processing pipeline: 1. Create :class:FootstepResolver → resolve a safe landing position for every touchdown frame. 2. :meth:_precompute_foot_reference → stance frames use the locked landing position, swing frames use Hermite/quintic interpolation + floor clamping. 3. :meth:_flatten_stance_quats → the sole stays level during stance (only yaw is kept).

    PARAMETER DESCRIPTION
    terrain

    Terrain object.

    TYPE: TerrainSource

    motion

    Mocap motion data.

    TYPE: MotionClip

    lookahead

    Terrain lookahead distance (m), lets the pelvis lift ahead of upcoming steps.

    TYPE: float DEFAULT: 0.0

    smoothing_alpha

    EMA smoothing coefficient for the pelvis z.

    def __init__(
    self,
    terrain: TerrainSource,
    motion: MotionClip,
    lookahead: float = 0.0,
    smoothing_alpha: float = 0.08,
    toe_offset_x: float | None = None,
    heel_offset_x: float = -0.04,
    mid_offset_x: float = 0.10,
    swing_floor_margin: float = 0.003,
    soft_reach_limit: float = 0.70,
    max_landing_shift: float = 0.05,
):
    robot_spec = motion.robot_spec
    if toe_offset_x is None:
        toe_offset_x = robot_spec.toe_probe_offset_x
    lfoot_idx = robot_spec.left_foot_index
    rfoot_idx = robot_spec.right_foot_index
    self.terrain = terrain
    self.motion = motion
    self.lookahead = float(lookahead)
    self.alpha = float(smoothing_alpha)
    self.swing_floor_margin = max(float(swing_floor_margin), 0.0)
    self.soft_reach_limit = max(float(soft_reach_limit), 0.1)
    self._ema_z = None  # exponential moving average of the pelvis z

    # Local x offsets of the foot key points: [heel, midfoot, toe].
    # FootstepResolver uses these three points to check whether the whole foot fits on a step.
    foot_point_offsets = np.array([heel_offset_x, mid_offset_x, toe_offset_x], dtype=np.float64)
    self.left_resolver = FootstepResolver(
        robot_spec=robot_spec,
        terrain=terrain,
        raw_foot=motion.links_pos[:, lfoot_idx],
        contact_mask=motion.left_contact,
        foot_nominal_z=motion.foot_nominal_z,
        foot_quats=motion.links_quat[:, lfoot_idx],
        foot_point_offsets=foot_point_offsets,
        toe_offset_x=toe_offset_x,
        max_landing_shift=max_landing_shift,
    )
    self.right_resolver = FootstepResolver(
        robot_spec=robot_spec,
        terrain=terrain,
        raw_foot=motion.links_pos[:, rfoot_idx],
        contact_mask=motion.right_contact,
        foot_nominal_z=motion.foot_nominal_z,
        foot_quats=motion.links_quat[:, rfoot_idx],
        foot_point_offsets=foot_point_offsets,
        toe_offset_x=toe_offset_x,
        max_landing_shift=max_landing_shift,
    )
    # Precompute the full foot reference trajectories
    # (stance frames = locked footholds, swing frames = interpolation).
    self.left_precomputed = self._precompute_foot_reference(self.left_resolver)
    self.right_precomputed = self._precompute_foot_reference(self.right_resolver)
    # Precompute the ankle reference quaternions (initialized to the raw mocap values).
    self.left_precomputed_quats = motion.links_quat[:, lfoot_idx].copy()
    self.right_precomputed_quats = motion.links_quat[:, rfoot_idx].copy()
    # Keep the sole level during stance: extract the yaw angle, drop pitch/roll.
    # On steps the foot should lie flat, not follow any sole tilt present in the mocap.
    self._flatten_stance_quats(self.left_precomputed_quats, motion.left_contact)
    self._flatten_stance_quats(self.right_precomputed_quats, motion.right_contact)

    # Enforce no lateral crossover between left and right foot references.
    # Check in pelvis local frame: left foot must stay on left side.
    self._enforce_no_crossover(motion, min_sep=0.08)
    # Enforce step-order consistency: the cross product of consecutive
    # left/right landing vectors must match the original motion's sign.
    self._enforce_step_order(motion)

    def update(self, pelvis_x: float, pelvis_y: float) -> float:
    """Single-frame update of the pelvis-z exponential moving average (EMA).

    Formula: ema_z += alpha * (target - ema_z).
    The smaller alpha, the smoother (but slower) the pelvis z response.
    For real-time per-frame use (not precomputation).

    Returns
    -------
    float
        The smoothed pelvis z reference for the current frame.
    """
    target = self._target_height(pelvis_x, pelvis_y)
    if self._ema_z is None:
        self._ema_z = target  # initialize directly on the first frame
    else:
        self._ema_z += self.alpha * (target - self._ema_z)
    return self._ema_z

    def segment_offsets(self, pelvis_positions: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Batch-compute EMA z offsets for a sequence of pelvis positions.

    Parameters
    ----------
    pelvis_positions : np.ndarray
        (N, 3) pelvis position sequence.

    Returns
    -------
    np.ndarray
        (N,) EMA-smoothed z reference per frame.
    """
    offsets = np.zeros(pelvis_positions.shape[0], dtype=np.float64)
    ema = 0.0 if self._ema_z is None else float(self._ema_z)
    for i, pelvis in enumerate(pelvis_positions):
        target = self._target_height(pelvis[0], pelvis[1])
        ema += self.alpha * (target - ema)
        offsets[i] = ema
    return offsets

    def build_segment(
    self,
    pelvis: np.ndarray,
    lfoot: np.ndarray,
    rfoot: np.ndarray,
    left_contact: np.ndarray,
    right_contact: np.ndarray,
    indices: np.ndarray,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    pelvis_z_offsets = self.segment_offsets(pelvis)

    ref_pelvis = pelvis.copy()
    ref_pelvis[:, 2] += pelvis_z_offsets
    idx = np.asarray(indices, dtype=np.int64)
    ref_lfoot = self.left_precomputed[idx].copy()
    ref_rfoot = self.right_precomputed[idx].copy()
    ref_lfoot_quats = self.left_precomputed_quats[idx].copy()
    ref_rfoot_quats = self.right_precomputed_quats[idx].copy()

    # Layer 1: enforce reachability by lowering pelvis z when either foot
    # exceeds the soft reach limit.  Compute pelvis-to-foot distance and
    # lower pelvis z per horizon step so that both legs stay within L_soft.
    L = self.soft_reach_limit
    for i in range(ref_pelvis.shape[0]):
        for foot in (ref_lfoot[i], ref_rfoot[i]):
            dxy = np.sqrt((ref_pelvis[i, 0] - foot[0]) ** 2 + (ref_pelvis[i, 1] - foot[1]) ** 2)
            # max allowed vertical distance given horizontal offset
            max_dz = np.sqrt(max(L**2 - dxy**2, 0.0))
            # pelvis must be above foot, so cap: pelvis_z <= foot_z + max_dz
            ref_pelvis[i, 2] = min(ref_pelvis[i, 2], foot[2] + max_dz)

    return ref_pelvis, ref_lfoot, ref_rfoot, ref_lfoot_quats, ref_rfoot_quats

    def stabilize_contact_mask(mask: np.ndarray, min_contact_frames: int = 4, min_swing_frames: int = 2) -> np.ndarray:
    """Remove contact runs shorter than ``min_contact_frames`` and fill swing gaps shorter
    than ``min_swing_frames`` that are surrounded by contact on both sides.
    """
    out = np.asarray(mask, dtype=bool).copy()
    n = out.shape[0]
    if n == 0:
        return out

    i = 0
    while i < n:
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and out[j] == out[i]:
            j += 1
        if out[i] and (j - i) < min_contact_frames:
            out[i:j] = False
        i = j

    i = 0
    while i < n:
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and out[j] == out[i]:
            j += 1
        if (not out[i]) and (j - i) < min_swing_frames:
            left_true = (i > 0) and out[i - 1]
            right_true = (j < n) and out[j]
            if left_true and right_true:
                out[i:j] = True
        i = j

    return out

    Gait phase¶

    Phase-clock gait analysis for bipedal motion capture data.

    Ported from Mondo-Robotics/PMT TCRS/stair_mppi/gait_phase.py @ 88838ca.

    Fits a global phase clock φ ∈ [0,1) to periodic locomotion data, with per-foot phase offsets θ_L, θ_R and swing ratios.

    Classifies: walking, running, hopping, galloping, standing.

    Key design choices: - Period estimation: hybrid of speed autocorrelation + speed minima touchdown detection. Autocorrelation works well for walking; speed minima work for running (where autocorrelation decays too fast). - Phase timeline: local phase resets at detected touchdowns prevent drift from stride frequency variation in long sequences. - Contact z threshold: 0.06 m by default, terrain-invariant. For data where foot z is not ground-referenced, the raw contact mask is empty and the clock is fitted from foot speed alone. - Clips with no significant flight phase are not fitted (fit_phase_clock returns None): z-based contact is reliable for them.

    Usage: from eden.extensions.motion_optimization.tcrs.gait_phase import fit_phase_clock, compute_per_frame_phase params = fit_phase_clock(lfoot_z, rfoot_z, lfoot_speed, rfoot_speed, fps) if params is not None: phase = compute_per_frame_phase(params, n_frames)

    def fit_phase_clock(
    lfoot_z: np.ndarray,
    rfoot_z: np.ndarray,
    lfoot_speed: np.ndarray,
    rfoot_speed: np.ndarray,
    fps: float,
    contact_z_threshold: float = 0.06,
    contact_speed_threshold: float = 0.5,
) -> GaitPhaseParams | None:
    """Fit phase clock parameters from motion capture data.

    Hybrid period estimation:
    1. Try speed minima touchdown detection (robust for running)
    2. Fallback to speed autocorrelation (better for slow walking)

    Parameters
    ----------
    lfoot_z : np.ndarray
        (N,) left foot z positions, m
    rfoot_z : np.ndarray
        (N,) right foot z positions, m
    lfoot_speed : np.ndarray
        (N,) left foot speed magnitude, m/s
    rfoot_speed : np.ndarray
        (N,) right foot speed magnitude, m/s
    fps : float
        frames per second
    contact_z_threshold : float
        foot z (m) below which a foot can be in raw contact
    contact_speed_threshold : float
        foot speed (m/s) below which a foot can be in raw contact

    Returns
    -------
    GaitPhaseParams or None
        None if the clip is shorter than 30 frames, has no significant flight phase (both
        feet off the ground in under 5% of frames by raw contact, where z-based contact is
        reliable), or is not periodic.
    """
    N = len(lfoot_z)
    if N < 30:
        return None

    # Raw contact masks (z-threshold, no stabilization — preserves short contacts)
    raw_left_contact = (lfoot_z < contact_z_threshold) & (lfoot_speed < contact_speed_threshold)
    raw_right_contact = (rfoot_z < contact_z_threshold) & (rfoot_speed < contact_speed_threshold)

    # Quick check: if raw contact never has both feet simultaneously off ground,
    # the gait is walking-like and z-based detection works fine.
    raw_flight = (~raw_left_contact) & (~raw_right_contact)
    flight_ratio = float(np.mean(raw_flight))
    if flight_ratio < 0.05:
        # Walking gait — no significant flight phase, z-based contact is reliable
        return None

    # Step 1: Detect touchdowns from speed minima
    left_tds = _detect_touchdowns(lfoot_speed)
    right_tds = _detect_touchdowns(rfoot_speed)

    # Step 2: Estimate period — primary: touchdown intervals
    period = _period_from_touchdowns(left_tds)
    period_R = _period_from_touchdowns(right_tds)
    if period is not None and period_R is not None:
        period = (period + period_R) / 2.0
    elif period is None:
        period = period_R

    # Fallback: autocorrelation
    if period is None:
        period = _period_from_autocorrelation(lfoot_speed)
    if period is None:
        period = _period_from_autocorrelation(rfoot_speed)
    if period is None:
        return None

    # Step 3: Phase offset
    # Primary: from touchdown timing; fallback: cross-correlation
    if len(left_tds) >= 2 and len(right_tds) >= 2:
        offset = _estimate_phase_offset_from_touchdowns(left_tds, right_tds, period)
    else:
        offset = _estimate_phase_offset_from_xcorr(lfoot_speed, rfoot_speed, period)

    # Step 4: Swing ratios (from z-based contact, reliable on flat ground)
    swing_ratio_L = _estimate_swing_ratio(raw_left_contact, left_tds, period)
    swing_ratio_R = _estimate_swing_ratio(raw_right_contact, right_tds, period)

    # Step 5: Build params and classify
    params = GaitPhaseParams(
        period_frames=period,
        period_sec=period / fps,
        swing_ratio_left=swing_ratio_L,
        swing_ratio_right=swing_ratio_R,
        phase_offset_left=0.0,
        phase_offset_right=offset,
        gait_type="",
        fit_quality=0.0,
        fps=fps,
        _left_touchdowns=left_tds,
        _right_touchdowns=right_tds,
    )

    offset_diff = min(offset, 1.0 - offset)
    avg_swing = (swing_ratio_L + swing_ratio_R) / 2.0

    if avg_swing < 0.05:
        gait_type = "stand"
    elif offset_diff > 0.35:
        gait_type = "run" if params.has_flight_phase else "walk"
    elif offset_diff < 0.1:
        gait_type = "hop"
    else:
        gait_type = "gallop"
    params.gait_type = gait_type

    # Step 6: Compute fit quality
    phase = compute_per_frame_phase(params, N)
    # If raw contact has any frames, compare
    if np.any(raw_left_contact) or np.any(raw_right_contact):
        agree_L = np.mean(phase.left_contact == raw_left_contact) if np.any(raw_left_contact) else 0.5
        agree_R = np.mean(phase.right_contact == raw_right_contact) if np.any(raw_right_contact) else 0.5
        params.fit_quality = (agree_L + agree_R) / 2.0
    else:
        # No raw contact frames (foot z not ground-referenced): nothing to compare
        # against, so a nominal quality.
        params.fit_quality = 0.7

    return params

    def compute_per_frame_phase(
    params: GaitPhaseParams,
    n_frames: int,
) -> PerFramePhase:
    """Compute per-frame phase, contact masks, and support weights.

    Uses detected touchdowns for piecewise linear phase (drift-resistant).
    """
    # Build global phase timeline from left foot touchdowns
    left_tds = params._left_touchdowns if params._left_touchdowns is not None else np.array([], dtype=int)
    global_phase = _build_phase_timeline(n_frames, params.period_frames, left_tds)

    # Local phases
    left_local = (global_phase + params.phase_offset_left) % 1.0
    right_local = (global_phase + params.phase_offset_right) % 1.0

    # Contact from phase: stance = local_phase < stance_ratio
    stance_ratio_L = 1.0 - params.swing_ratio_left
    stance_ratio_R = 1.0 - params.swing_ratio_right
    left_contact = left_local < stance_ratio_L
    right_contact = right_local < stance_ratio_R

    flight_mask = (~left_contact) & (~right_contact)

    # Continuous support weights
    support_weight_left = np.ones(n_frames, dtype=np.float64)
    support_weight_right = np.ones(n_frames, dtype=np.float64)

    # Left foot: cosine decay during swing
    swing_mask_L = ~left_contact
    if params.swing_ratio_left > 1e-6:
        swing_progress_L = (left_local[swing_mask_L] - stance_ratio_L) / params.swing_ratio_left
        swing_progress_L = np.clip(swing_progress_L, 0.0, 1.0)
        support_weight_left[swing_mask_L] = 0.5 * (1.0 + np.cos(np.pi * swing_progress_L))

    # Right foot: cosine decay during swing
    swing_mask_R = ~right_contact
    if params.swing_ratio_right > 1e-6:
        swing_progress_R = (right_local[swing_mask_R] - stance_ratio_R) / params.swing_ratio_right
        swing_progress_R = np.clip(swing_progress_R, 0.0, 1.0)
        support_weight_right[swing_mask_R] = 0.5 * (1.0 + np.cos(np.pi * swing_progress_R))

    return PerFramePhase(
        global_phase=global_phase,
        left_local_phase=left_local,
        right_local_phase=right_local,
        left_contact=left_contact,
        right_contact=right_contact,
        flight_mask=flight_mask,
        support_weight_left=support_weight_left,
        support_weight_right=support_weight_right,
    )

    Foot-swing optimization (MPPI)¶

    MPPI (Model Predictive Path Integral) foot swing trajectory optimizer.

    Sampling-based foot swing planner. Uses cubic-spline-parameterized control points with a pre-computed basis matrix for fast batch expansion.

    Usage: from eden.extensions.motion_optimization.tcrs.mppi_foot import MppiFootOptimizer, MppiFootParams opt = MppiFootOptimizer(MppiFootParams()) traj_x, traj_y, traj_z = opt.optimize_swing( liftoff_pos, landing_pos, swing_duration, ref_traj, ref_times, terrain )

    Also exposes slerp_quaternion, used throughout the planner stack.

    Ported from Mondo-Robotics/PMT TCRS/stair_mppi/mppi_foot.py @ 88838ca.

    def optimize_swing(
    self,
    liftoff_pos: np.ndarray,
    landing_pos: np.ndarray,
    swing_duration: float,
    ref_traj: np.ndarray,
    ref_times: np.ndarray,
    terrain: TerrainSource,
    v_start: np.ndarray | None = None,
    v_end: np.ndarray | None = None,
    phase_stance_mask: np.ndarray | None = None,
    phase_swing_envelope: np.ndarray | None = None,
) -> tuple[EvalWrapper, EvalWrapper, EvalWrapper]:
    """Optimize the xyz trajectory of one swing.

    ``v_start``/``v_end`` are ignored (the clamped spline boundary conditions
    fix zero endpoint velocity). The optional phase-aware inputs (None = disabled)
    are ``phase_stance_mask``, an ``(n_dense,)`` bool mask of stance samples along
    the dense times, and ``phase_swing_envelope``, an ``(n_dense,)`` swing
    intensity in [0, 1].

    Returns
    -------
    tuple[EvalWrapper, EvalWrapper, EvalWrapper]
        ``(traj_x, traj_y, traj_z)``, each with an ``.eval(t)`` method over ``[0, swing_duration]``.
    """
    p = self.params
    n_knots_inner = p.n_knots
    n_knots_total = n_knots_inner + 2  # Including the two boundary points

    # ---- Time setup ----
    dense_times = np.linspace(0.0, swing_duration, p.n_dense)
    knot_times = np.linspace(0.0, swing_duration, n_knots_total)

    # ---- Pre-compute the basis matrix ----
    B_full = _build_basis_matrix(knot_times, dense_times)
    # Separate boundary columns from interior columns
    B_start = B_full[:, 0]  # (n_dense,)
    B_end = B_full[:, -1]  # (n_dense,)
    B_inner = B_full[:, 1:-1]  # (n_dense, n_knots_inner)

    # Boundary contribution: (n_dense, 3) — contribution of the fixed endpoints to the trajectory
    boundary_contrib = B_start[:, None] * liftoff_pos[None, :] + B_end[:, None] * landing_pos[None, :]

    # ---- Interpolate the reference trajectory onto dense_times ----
    ref_interp = np.column_stack(
        [np.interp(dense_times, ref_times, ref_traj[:, d]) for d in range(3)]
    )  # (n_dense, 3)

    # ---- Clearance envelope: sin²(πφ), zero at endpoints, maximal in the middle ----
    phi = dense_times / max(swing_duration, 1e-12)
    swing_envelope = np.sin(np.pi * phi) ** 2
    clearance = p.h_clearance * 2.0 * swing_envelope  # (n_dense,)

    # ---- Height upper bound ----
    z_ceiling = max(liftoff_pos[2], landing_pos[2]) + p.ceiling_margin

    # ---- Initialize mu: linearly interpolate the interior points ----
    mu = np.zeros((n_knots_inner, 3), dtype=np.float64)
    for i in range(n_knots_inner):
        alpha = (i + 1) / (n_knots_inner + 1)
        mu[i] = (1 - alpha) * liftoff_pos + alpha * landing_pos

    # ---- Noise standard deviation per channel ----
    noise_std = np.array([p.noise_std_xy, p.noise_std_xy, p.noise_std_z], dtype=np.float64)

    # ---- MPPI iterations ----
    for _iter in range(p.n_iterations):
        # Sampling: (n_samples, n_knots_inner, 3)
        noise = self.rng.normal(size=(p.n_samples, n_knots_inner, 3))
        noise *= noise_std[None, None, :]
        samples = mu[None, :, :] + noise
        samples[0] = mu  # Sample 0 = current mean (noise-free)

        # Expand to dense trajectories: (n_samples, n_dense, 3)
        # trajs = boundary_contrib + B_inner @ samples_per_channel
        trajs = boundary_contrib[None, :, :] + np.einsum("hk,ikd->ihd", B_inner, samples)

        # Terrain query: (n_samples, n_dense)
        terrain_z = np.empty((p.n_samples, p.n_dense), dtype=np.float64)
        for i in range(p.n_samples):
            terrain_z[i] = terrain.height_batch(trajs[i, :, 0], trajs[i, :, 1])

        # Compute costs
        costs = self._cost_batch(
            trajs,
            terrain_z,
            ref_interp,
            clearance,
            z_ceiling,
            phase_stance_mask=phase_stance_mask,
            phase_swing_envelope=phase_swing_envelope,
        )

        # Softmax weighting
        beta = costs.min()
        weights = np.exp(-(costs - beta) / p.temperature)
        w_sum = weights.sum()
        if w_sum < 1e-30:
            weights = np.ones(p.n_samples) / p.n_samples
        else:
            weights /= w_sum

        # Update mu
        mu = np.einsum("i,ijk->jk", weights, samples)

    # ---- Final trajectory ----
    final_traj = boundary_contrib + B_inner @ mu  # (n_dense, 3)

    return (
        EvalWrapper(dense_times, final_traj[:, 0]),
        EvalWrapper(dense_times, final_traj[:, 1]),
        EvalWrapper(dense_times, final_traj[:, 2]),
    )

    def slerp_quaternion(q0_wxyz: np.ndarray, q1_wxyz: np.ndarray, t: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """SLERP between two [w,x,y,z] quaternions. Returns (N, 4) in [w,x,y,z].

    Aligns q1 to the same hemisphere as q0 (flips if dot < 0) to ensure
    shortest-arc interpolation — avoids unexpected 360 degree foot rotations.
    """
    t = np.asarray(t, dtype=np.float64)
    q0 = np.asarray(q0_wxyz, dtype=np.float64)
    q1 = np.asarray(q1_wxyz, dtype=np.float64)
    if np.dot(q0, q1) < 0.0:
        q1 = -q1
    q0_xyzw = np.array([q0[1], q0[2], q0[3], q0[0]])
    q1_xyzw = np.array([q1[1], q1[2], q1[3], q1[0]])
    rots = Rotation.from_quat(np.stack([q0_xyzw, q1_xyzw]))
    slerp_obj = Slerp([0.0, 1.0], rots)
    interp = slerp_obj(np.clip(t, 0.0, 1.0))
    q_xyzw = interp.as_quat()
    return np.column_stack([q_xyzw[:, 3], q_xyzw[:, 0], q_xyzw[:, 1], q_xyzw[:, 2]])

    Pelvis-height filtering¶

    Support-aware pelvis-z filtering for terrain reference warping.

    Smooths a per-frame absolute pelvis-z target with an asymmetric EMA and a per-frame rate limit, so the root tracks terrain height changes without step discontinuities. The caller (the pipeline's pelvis-z retargeting stage) constructs the target; this filter only smooths it.

    Ported from Mondo-Robotics/PMT TCRS/stair_mppi/terrain_warp.py @ 88838ca (the SupportAwareRootZFilter.step path only; upstream's legacy TerrainReferenceWarper / raw-foot-data filter path is dead code and was not ported).

    def step(self, z_target: float, is_flight: bool = False) -> float:
    """Smooth *one* externally-constructed z_target.

    Parameters
    ----------
    z_target : float
        Absolute pelvis z target for this frame.
    is_flight : bool
        If True, track with at least ``flight_alpha``.

    Returns
    -------
    float
        Smoothed pelvis z.
    """
    if self._ema_z is None:
        self._ema_z = float(z_target)
        return self._ema_z

    alpha = self.alpha_up if z_target > self._ema_z else self.alpha_down
    if is_flight:
        alpha = max(alpha, self.flight_alpha)

    ema_target = self._ema_z + alpha * (z_target - self._ema_z)
    dz = min(max(ema_target - self._ema_z, -self.max_delta), self.max_delta)
    self._ema_z = self._ema_z + dz
    return self._ema_z

    Whole-body IK¶

    MuJoCo damped-least-squares whole-body IK on the leg joints.

    The root pose is fixed (or softly tracked in :meth:JacobianIK.solve_with_root) to the target root pose. Upper-body joints are held to the provided reference joint angles. Only the leg joints are updated. Foot targets are tracked as multi-point constraints (ankle body plus virtual toe and heel points offset in the ankle frame), with asymmetric penetration weighting and a deterministic multi-seed restart for hard frames.

    Robot geometry (link/DOF names, toe/heel contact offsets) comes from :class:~eden.options.extensions.motion_optimization.TCRSRobotOptions; nothing is hardcoded to the G1 beyond the defaults that spec carries.

    Ported from Mondo-Robotics/PMT TCRS/stair_mppi/ghost_ik.py @ 88838ca (class G1GhostJacobianIK; config loading takes the dict from TCRSRobotOptions.ik_config instead of a JSON path).
